item.title: Sausage Gochujang Ragatoni
item.description:
• ⏲️ Prep time: 30 min
  • 🍳 Cook time: 20 min
  • 🍽️ Servings: 4

Ingredients

  • 1 shallot
  • 3 garlic cloves
  • 6 pork sausages
  • 2 tbsp butter
  • 2 tbsp gochujang
  • 220 ml single cream
  • 2 tbsp honey
  • 2 limes
  • 40g parmesan
  • 400g rigatnoi
  • 30g fresh coriander
  • 15g panko breadcrumbs

Directions

  1. Mince shallot and garlic.

  2. Heat olive oil in pan. Add sausages. Fry until browned. Add splash of water to deglaze and remove meat.

item.title: Aubergine Banh Mi
item.description:
• ⏲️ Prep time: 30 min
  • 🍳 Cook time: 20 min
  • 🍽️ Servings: 2

Ingredients

  • aubergine
  • 2 part-baked baguettes
  • 1 tbsp rice vinegar
  • 1/2 tbsp caster sugar
  • 1 smaller carrot
  • 3 radishes
  • 1/4 cucumber
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 tbsp gochujang
  • 1 tsp dark soy sauce
  • 1 tbsp dark brown sugar
  • 1 tsp toasted sesame oil
  • 1 tsp mirin
  • 1 garlic clove
  • fresh root ginger
  • 1 tsp sesame seeds
  • 2 tbsp mayonnaise
  • 1 bunch coriander

Directions

  1. Preheat the oven to 180C Fan/Gas 4. Top and tail the aubergines and cut lengthways in half, and then each half lengthways again into 4 wedges. Sprinkle the flesh with salt and leave for 10 minutes.
